The '''Darek system''' was in the [[Rachuk sector/Legends|Rachuk sector]], between [[Morobe system]] and [[Hensara system/Legends|Hensara system]]. [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|jumped]] here to throw off [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] trackers.
